items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public authorities law and the state finance law, in relation to creating the zero carbon emission investment program and zero carbon emission investment program fund
items.lawCode: Add Art 8 Title 9-B §§1900 - 1906, Pub Auth L; add §99-bb, St Fin L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S6605

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the public authorities law and the state finance law,
in relation to creating the zero carbon emission investment program
and zero carbon emission investment program fund

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :

This bill would establish the zero carbon emissions investment program
and fund to provide the State's upstate nuclear facilities with funds
in recognition of their zero carbon emitting attributes.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

Section 1 of the bill would add a new title to the public authorities
law directing the public service commission to establish the zero
carbon emission investment program and directing the new york state
energy research and development authority to administer such program.
This section also provides the definitions for the Zero Carbon
Emission Investment Program, authorizes NYSERDA to establish,
calculate, and issue the program to provide awards for zero carbon
emitters for their avoidance of carbon emission although capital
funding from the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, and requires
NYSERDA to submit an annual report to the Governor and Legislature
describing the authority's activities related to the, Zero Carbon
Emission Investment Program.

Section 2 amends the State Finance Law and establishes the Zero Carbon
Emission Investment Program Fund in the joint custody of the
Comptroller and the Commissioner of Taxation and Finance.

Section 3 provides that funds from the sale of Regional Greenhouse Gas
Initiative credits will be used to fund this program.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Nuclear power is a clean and reliable form of electric generation. It
has zero carbon emissions. Renewable sources of power generation are
given financial assistance because of their clean characteristics, and
to ensure New York can meet its renewable targets must offer nuclear
generators similar financial assistance.

This bill would provide nuclear facilities financial assistance, while
not adding another fee or surcharge to the state's ratepayers. New
York State has some of the highest rates in the country, even at a
time of record low costs for energy production. The high rates are a
result of already very substantial added fees and assessments on bills
dedicated to clean energy, which must be first tapped to address this
issue before asking ratepayers to give more of their dollars to this
effort.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the state.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

summary: Creates zero carbon emission investment program and fund; proceeds collected from the auction or sale of carbon dioxide emission allowances administered under the regional greenhouse gas initiative shall be used to fund the zero carbon emission investment program.
